content:
### The Roofing Market Timing Problem

Roofing is one of the most weather-dependent trades in residential services. When a hail event hits a suburban market, every roofing company in the region floods affected neighborhoods simultaneously. Homeowners are overwhelmed with door knocks, mailers, and digital ads — all within the same 48-hour window.

The companies that win in this environment are rarely the ones who showed up loudest after the storm. They are the ones homeowners already recognized before the storm.



### What Structured Presence Looks Like for a Roofing Company

SIT GroundForce™ establishes consistent, structured neighborhood outreach in defined roofing territories across the Chicago North Shore and Greater Milwaukee suburbs — before the next weather event creates a scramble.

One roofing partner per defined territory. Systematic neighborhood presence through trained outreach teams. Homeowners see and interact with your brand consistently over months.

 

### The North Shore and Milwaukee Suburb Advantage

The Chicago North Shore — including Wilmette, Winnetka, Glencoe, Highland Park, and Lake Forest — and the Greater Milwaukee suburbs represent high-value roofing markets where average project values are significantly above statewide medians.

Homeowners in these markets make decisions based on trust and familiarity, not lowest bid. That dynamic favors the contractor with the strongest neighborhood presence.

 

### Territory Availability Is Finite

SIT™ approves one roofing partner per defined territory. As territories are filled ,that category closes for additional partners. Current evaluations are open for select North Shore Chicago and Greater Milwaukee roofing territories.
